rule.name: GlobalStateLeakInTest
rule.message: This test changes process-wide state and nothing in the class puts it back, so the tests after it pass or fail depending on the order they run in. Save the old value and restore it in finally or in an @AfterEach or @AfterAll method, or let an extension set and restore it: junit-pioneer @SetSystemProperty, @RestoreSystemProperties, @DefaultLocale or @DefaultTimeZone, a system-stubs @SystemStub field, or system-lambda restoreSystemProperties(...).

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $typeOf := function($n) { string(($n/*[1][self::TypeExpression]/ClassType/@SimpleName, $n/*[1][self::AmbiguousName][matches(@Name, '^[A-Z]\w*[a-z]\w*$')]/@Name)[1]) }, $familyOf := function($n) { let $type := $typeOf($n), $name := string(($n/@MethodName, $n/@Name)[1]) return concat($type, '.', if ($type = 'System' and $name = ('setProperty', 'clearProperty', 'setProperties')) then 'property' else if ($type = 'Security' and $name = ('addProvider', 'insertProviderAt', 'removeProvider')) then 'provider' else if (matches($name, '^set[A-Z]')) then concat(lower-case(substring($name, 4, 1)), substring($name, 5)) else $name) }, $jdk := function($n) { exists($n/self::MethodCall/*[1][self::TypeExpression][ (pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.System') and ../@MethodName = ('setProperty', 'clearProperty', 'setProperties', 'setOut', 'setErr', 'setIn')) or ((pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Locale') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.TimeZone') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.CookieHandler') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.Authenticator') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.ProxySelector') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.ResponseCache') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.net.ssl.SSLContext')) and ../@MethodName = 'setDefault') or (pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Thread') and ../@MethodName = 'setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler') or (pmd-java:typeIs('java.security.Security') and ../@MethodName = ('addProvider', 'insertProviderAt')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('javax.net.ssl.HttpsURLConnection') and ../@MethodName = ('setDefaultSSLSocketFactory', 'setDefaultHostnameVerifier'))]) }, $project := function($n) { let $type := $typeOf($n), $unit := $n/ancestor::CompilationUnit, $parts := tokenize(string($unit/@PackageName), '\.'), $depth := if ($parts[2] = ('github', 'gitlab', 'bitbucket')) then 3 else if ($parts[1] = ('com', 'org', 'net', 'io', 'dev', 'app', 'co', 'me', 'ai', 'edu', 'gov', 'info', 'de', 'fr', 'uk', 'nl', 'ch', 'be', 'it', 'es', 'se', 'no', 'fi', 'dk', 'pl', 'at', 'cz', 'ru', 'cn', 'jp', 'kr', 'in', 'br', 'au', 'ca', 'us', 'eu')) then 2 else 1, $prefix := string-join($parts[position() le $depth], '.'), $qualifier := string($n/*[1]/ClassType/@PackageQualifier), $imports := $unit/ImportDeclaration[@Static = false()][@ImportOnDemand = false()][@ImportedSimpleName = $type], $owned := function($package) { $prefix != '' and ($package = $prefix or starts-with($package, concat($prefix, '.'))) } return $type != '' and not($type = ('System', 'Thread', 'Runtime')) and ($n/self::FieldAccess or (matches(string($n/@MethodName), '^set[A-Z]') and not(matches(string($n/@MethodName), '^setUp([A-Z]|$)')))) and not($unit//(ClassDeclaration | EnumDeclaration | RecordDeclaration | InterfaceDeclaration)[@SimpleName = $type]) and (if ($qualifier != '') then $owned($qualifier) else if (exists($imports)) then (some $import in $imports satisfies $owned(string($import/@PackageName))) else true()) } return //(MethodCall | FieldAccess[@AccessType = 'WRITE'])[$jdk(.) or $project(.)] [let $change := ., $family := $familyOf(.), $type := $typeOf(.), $classes := ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::AnonymousClassDeclaration], $methods := $classes/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration, $afters := $methods[ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = ('AfterEach', 'AfterAll', 'After', 'AfterClass', 'AfterMethod', 'AfterTest', 'AfterSuite', 'AfterGroups') or @Name = ('afterEach', 'afterAll', 'afterTestExecution', 'afterTestMethod', 'afterTestClass', 'after', 'close', 'tearDown')], $helpers := $methods[@Name = $afters//MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]]/@MethodName], $finally := ancestor::*[self::MethodDeclaration or self::ConstructorDeclaration or self::Initializer][1]//FinallyClause, $sites := ($afters | $helpers | $finally), $tests := $methods[ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = ('Test', 'ParameterizedTest', 'RepeatedTest', 'TestFactory', 'TestTemplate')], $zones := ($sites | (if (exists($tests)) then () else $classes[last()])), $hosts := ancestor::LambdaExpression/parent::ArgumentList/parent::MethodCall, $resources := ancestor::Block[parent::TryStatement[ResourceList]]/../ResourceList //(ClassType/@SimpleName | AmbiguousName/@Name | MethodCall/@MethodName), $marks := (($classes | ancestor::MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName, $classes/ClassBody/FieldDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation/@SimpleName = ('SystemStub', 'Rule', 'ClassRule', 'RegisterExtension')] /ClassType/@SimpleName, $hosts/@MethodName, $hosts[@MethodName = 'execute']/*[1]/descendant-or-self::*/(self::MethodCall/@MethodName | self::ClassType/@SimpleName)), $extensions := map { 'System.property': ('RestoreSystemProperties', 'SystemProperties', 'ProvideSystemProperty', 'ClearSystemProperties', 'restoreSystemProperties', 'withSystemProperty'), 'Locale.default': ('DefaultLocale'), 'TimeZone.default': ('DefaultTimeZone'), 'System.out': ('SystemOut', 'SystemOutRule', 'SystemErrAndOut', 'StdIo', 'tapSystemOut', 'tapSystemOutNormalized', 'tapSystemErrAndOut', 'tapSystemErrAndOutNormalized'), 'System.err': ('SystemErr', 'SystemErrRule', 'SystemErrAndOut', 'tapSystemErr', 'tapSystemErrNormalized', 'tapSystemErrAndOut', 'tapSystemErrAndOutNormalized'), 'System.in': ('SystemIn', 'TextFromStandardInputStream', 'StdIo', 'withTextFromSystemIn') } return not( exists(ancestor::* intersect $sites) or $resources = ($type, $extensions($family)) or $marks = $extensions($family) or (some $restore in $zones//(MethodCall | FieldAccess[@AccessType = 'WRITE'])[not(. is $change)] satisfies ($familyOf($restore) = $family or (not($jdk($change)) and $typeOf($restore) = $type and matches(string($restore/@MethodName), '^(reset|clear|restore)')))))]
